text: Given valid Datto credentials, When dattormm_get_alerts is called with no device_uid/site_uid/status, Then it calls GET /api/v2/account/alerts/open and returns {items,count,limit,offset,has_more[,next_offset,total_count]}
Given status="resolved", When dattormm_get_alerts is called, Then it calls GET /api/v2/account/alerts/resolved instead of /open
Given a device_uid, When dattormm_get_alerts is called, Then it calls GET /api/v2/device/{device_uid}/alerts/{status} and only that device's alerts are returned
Given a site_uid, When dattormm_get_alerts is called, Then it calls GET /api/v2/site/{site_uid}/alerts/{status} and only that site's alerts are returned
Given both device_uid and site_uid are passed, When dattormm_get_alerts is called, Then it returns the invalid_argument envelope and no HTTP request is made
Given a page cut short by the 20,000-char response cap, When the next call passes offset=next_offset, Then no alert is skipped or repeated across the two calls
Given a valid alert_uid and confirm=true, When dattormm_resolve_alert is called, Then it calls POST /api/v2/alert/{alert_uid}/resolve and returns Datto's response
Given confirm is omitted or false, When dattormm_resolve_alert is called, Then it returns the invalid_argument envelope and never calls Datto's resolve endpoint
Given an alert_uid that Datto returns 404 for (unknown or belonging to another tenant), When dattormm_resolve_alert is called, Then it returns the not_found envelope

Given missing or invalid Datto credentials, When dattormm_get_alerts or dattormm_resolve_alert is called, Then it returns the same NO_TOKEN/401 behavior the existing tools already give, with no separate code path
Given two tenants' credentials used concurrently (the existing CookieDatto fixture), When each calls dattormm_get_alerts, Then neither tenant's request carries a cookie or token set for the other
Given tools/list is requested, Then dattormm_get_alerts (readOnlyHint) and dattormm_resolve_alert (destructiveHint, alert_uid required, confirm optional) are both reported with the documented schema
Field verification: GET /api/v2/account/alerts/open against a real Datto RMM tenant returns the documented paging envelope and alert record shape (alertUid, timestamp, alertContext)
steps: Obtain a real Datto RMM tenant's API Key/Secret (trial/sandbox or explicit customer-consented account)
Call dattormm_get_alerts with those credentials via the deployed server
Compare the raw response against the documented shape (pageDetails/items keys, alertUid/timestamp/alertContext fields)
expect: Response matches the documented shape closely enough for fetch_page's generic pageDetails/nextPageUrl handling to compute has_more/next_offset correctly; any mismatch is filed as a follow-up, not silently absorbed
evidence: No Datto RMM test account is available in this environment; not a blocker per references/mcp-track.md §2.5 (missing vendor test account does not block design or dev)

text: Field verification: POST /api/v2/alert/{alertUid}/resolve against a real open alert on a real Datto RMM tenant actually resolves it and returns a response this tool can pass through sensibly
steps: Obtain a real Datto RMM tenant with at least one real open alert
Check the alert's state in Datto afterward (e.g. via dattormm_get_alerts status=resolved) and record the exact response shape returned by the resolve call
expect: The alert moves from the open list to the resolved list; the resolve call's response is recorded for comparison against this design's assumption (passthrough, no documented response schema)
evidence: No Datto RMM test account is available in this environment; not a blocker per references/mcp-track.md §2.5
